name: Imperial Palaces of the Ming and Qing Dynasties in Beijing and Shenyang
description: Two imperial palaces in northern China, in Beijing and Shenyang, mark the rise and rule of the Ming and Qing emperors. Beijing's Forbidden City, home to rulers from 1416 to 1911, spreads its nearly 10,000 rooms and gardens across a vast walled compound. Shenyang's smaller palace, with 114 buildings, shows the Manchu roots of the last dynasty before it moved south.
